profile_text.body:
Datadog, Inc. describes itself as offering cloud monitoring as a service. Its website says users can see metrics from all apps, tools, and services in one place. The site also describes an integration of security and observability intended to defend against AI-powered attacks, with claims about decoding runtime execution, eliminating exposure in dynamic AI environments, and executing detection and response with agentic speed.

Datadog, Inc. is a public company headquartered in New York, NY, with ticker DDOG and CIK 0001561550. It also appears under the alias DATADOG INC - CLASS A. New York law exposure records list 458 matters involving the company.
